messages.text: Morning all ☕ Quick one — anyone else seeing learners' OTJ jump overnight? Two of mine went up by 2.5 hours each for a workshop they also logged manually last week.
Yes! That's the Teams attendance import. Since 14 Oct Aptiva flags the duplicates in amber on the OTJ log — you need to reject the manual entry, not the imported one.
Ah, legend. I've been deleting the wrong one 🙈

Confirming what Fatima said. Imported entries have the little Teams icon and the session ID — always keep those. Reject manual duplicates with reason 'Duplicate – auto-imported'. Compliance can then see why the hours changed.

Reminder: Red learners' overdue reviews need to be booked by Friday. If the line manager can't make it, book with a nominated workplace mentor (new rule from the team meeting) but still get employer sign-off.
Mine are all in except Raymond at Arden Retail — manager's on leave until the 16th. Booked the mentor for the 12th.

For anyone who missed the demo — I'm writing up a Copilot prompt for review summaries. Current version: "Using the transcript of this meeting, draft a progress review summary for [learner] covering KSB progress, OTJ position, employer feedback and 3 SMART targets. Plain English, under 200 words. Leave out any health or personal details."
Tried that on yesterday's review — took 2 mins and I only changed one target. Saved me a good 20 minutes of typing at 6pm 😅
Small reminder from the Functional Skills side: maths and English study does NOT count as OTJ, so please don't let learners log FS sessions in the OTJ log. I've spotted a few this month.
Good shout Emily. Same goes for the progress review itself — doesn't count either.
Question for Kate: if a learner transfers from DT3 to DA4, does their OTJ carry over? Saw one show as zero last week.

It carries over if the transfer is done as a 'programme change' rather than a new enrolment. The zero issue was a bad transfer — fixed now. Raise a FixDesk ticket (category 'Aptiva access / sync') if you see it again.
Great thread, everyone. Fatima — can you pin your prompt in the channel once it's final?
